meta.title: Dunia — video chat with people around the world
onb.name.title: What should people call you?
onb.name.hint: This is the name other people see. You can change it later.
onb.gender.title: Are you male or female?
onb.gender.hint: Used when people choose who they want to meet.
onb.country.title: Where are you from?
onb.country.detected: We filled this in from your connection. Change it if it's wrong.
onb.country.choose: Choose the country you live in.
onb.country.locked: Your country is set from your connection.
onb.langs.title: Languages you speak
onb.langs.hint: Pick up to 3. We'll try to match you with people you can talk to.
onb.age: I'm 18 or older and I agree to the {link}.
onb.cam.title: Turn on your camera
onb.cam.hint: Your browser will ask for camera and microphone access. Your video goes straight to the person you're talking to, not through our servers.
err.name_blocked: That name isn't allowed. Try another one.
err.age: You must be 18 or older to use Dunia.
err.rate_limited: Slow down a little and try again.
lobby.title: Talk to someone new, right now.
lobby.sub: One tap connects you to a real person somewhere in the world. Skip anytime.
lobby.safety: Video is peer-to-peer. You can skip, block or report anyone at any time.
filter.title: Who do you want to meet?
cam.blockedHint: Allow camera and microphone in your browser's site settings, then try again.
cam.insecureHint: Open Dunia over https (or on localhost). Browsers block cameras on insecure pages.
cam.notFoundHint: Check that your camera is connected and not being used by another app.
search.title: Finding someone…
search.quiet: It's quiet with these filters right now.
connecting.title: Connecting…
chat.title: Chat
chat.hint: Say hi! Messages disappear when the chat ends.
chat.translateFail: Translation isn't available for this message in your browser.
chat.filtered: Links and contact details are hidden to keep you safe.
report.title: Report {name}
report.hint: You'll be moved to someone new right away. Moderators receive a still image of their video and their recent messages.
report.done: Thanks. Your report was sent to our moderators.
block.title: Block {name}?
block.hint: You won't be matched with each other again.
block.done: Blocked. You won't be matched again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.speaker: Speaker
settings.safeView: Blur new video until I tap it
settings.autoNext: Find someone new automatically when a chat ends
toast.tooMany: Too many connections from your network. Close other tabs and try again.
banned.title: Your access is paused
banned.until: Reports showed a break of our Community Guidelines. You can use Dunia again after {time}.
banned.permanent: Reports showed a serious break of our Community Guidelines.
